JsLibrary::register_rs2b0t.when: once per frontend session: TuiSession::fill_rs2b0t_cards_once / on_script_browse_open / import_rs2b0t_catalog; panel Session same names. Flag rs2b0t_filled never clears on profile rebind.
JsLibrary::register_rs2b0t.inputs: catalog root + persisted rs2b0t-path. No SelectedGameData. No V8.
JsLibrary::register_rs2b0t.schema_owner: JsCard.settings_schema cloned from parse_registry_with_sources -> settings_blob(Alcher.ts + same-dir AlcherLogic.ts) -> parse_settings_export(ALCHER_SETTINGS).

profile_bind.SharedClientTemplate::load: crates/host-play/src/lib.rs: for_optional_profile(revision, cache_id) then store Option<Arc<SelectedGameData>> beside cache/world.
profile_bind.TUI: run() binds profile first (resolve/bind/load/new_bound) then later Browse registers cards. TuiSession.template.game_data() exists before Play and before Start.
profile_bind.panel: install_prepared_template sets server_profile + template. Session::selected_game_data() re-queries for_optional_profile from the bound profile. Catalog register is independent and once.

Start.LoadIsolate: content_json(game_data) posts __rs2b0t_host.content then load_modules. ITEM_DB becomes non-empty only here.

Params_before_Start.TUI: ParamsPane.resolve_setting_options(def, loadouts) only. No game_data field. bin.rs draw_params_overlay / params_on_key pass session.loadouts.
Params_before_Start.panel: script_parameter_editors uses resolve_setting_options(def, &session.loadouts) only, even though selected_game_data() already exists.
Params_before_Start.choice_ui: non-empty resolve result selects chip/combo; empty string[] falls through to free-text.

resolve_setting_options_today.behavior: if def.options not empty, clone; else if options_from == 'loadouts', store names; else empty. No SelectedGameData.
callers: crates/panel/src/app.rs script_parameter_editors (string combo and string[] checkboxes)

why_not_register_overload.register_is_once: rs2b0t_filled stays true across panel finish_profile_preparation / install_prepared_template.
why_not_register_overload.baking_options_into_JsCard: would freeze one revision's membership/order into process catalog schema, or require mutating cards on rebind.
why_not_register_overload.File_Load: JsLibrary restore / load file uses settings_schema_from_source(origin) looking for export const SETTINGS, not ALCHER_SETTINGS. Do not expand that path.

why_typed_descriptor.pattern: options_from: 'loadouts' already defers combo contents from register-time schema to Params paint.
why_typed_descriptor.both_frontends: already call resolve_setting_options at paint/key. Threading Option<&SelectedGameData> is the same seam.
why_typed_descriptor.no_selected_facts: for_optional_profile returns None on cache mismatch; offline/legacy Play carries None. Resolver must not publish FODDER aliases then.
